description: This file is a PHP unit test class for testing the BuzzDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup, various CRUD, and query tests for BuzzPost, BuzzShare, BuzzLink, BuzzPhoto, and related entities, using mock services and fixtures.

classes.name: BuzzDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for verifying the functionality of the BuzzDao data access object in OrangeHRM, including methods for posts, shares, videos, photos, comments, and associated filters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test fixtures by loading test data into the database/posts for each test case.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Buzz feed posts with specific filter parameters, validating properties of the returned Post objects against expected values.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of buzz feed posts with given filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Tests fetching photo IDs associated with specific post IDs, including cases for posts with no photos or non-existent posts.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPost
methods.description: Tests creation and persistence of a new BuzzPost with mocked current timestamp.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzShare
methods.description: Tests creation and saving of a BuzzShare associated with a BuzzPost.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Tests creation and persistence of a BuzzLink (video) associated with a BuzzPost.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPhotos
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzPhoto, reading image data from a file, and verifying retrieval and resource handling.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost1
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzPost and its associated shares.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost2
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzPost with attached photos and shares.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost3
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzPost with an associated BuzzLink.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare1
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzShare and automatic cleanup of associated shares.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare2
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzShare with attached video link and associated posts/shares removal.

methods.name: testGetBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Validates fetching a BuzzShare by post ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Buzz share list for a specific post ID with given filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList2
methods.description: Verifies empty result for a post ID that has no shares.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount1
methods.description: Checks the count of shares for a specific post ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount2
methods.description: Verifies that a nonexistent or unshared post returns zero count.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment by ID and share ID, verifying text and likes.

methods.name: testGetBuzzComments
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific share ID and checks their count.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Verifies count of comments for a specific share ID.
